title: John Chrysostom on Judges 2:1
body: “For if the word spoken by angels was steadfast." What is "was steadfast"? True, as one may say; and faithful in its proper season; and all the things which had been spoken came to pass.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on John and Hebrews
bodyEs: “Porque si la palabra dicha por los ángeles fué firme." ¿Qué es "fué firme"? Verdadera, como quien dice; y fiel en su tiempo propio; y todas las cosas que se habían dicho se cumplieron.”

title: Basil the Great on Judges 5:27
body: “I suggest this rendering of propompai ton exodeuonton with hesitation, and feel no certainty about the passage except that the Ben.”
author: Basil the Great, Hexaemeron
bodyEs: “Sugiero esta traducción de propompai ton exodeuonton con vacilación, y no tengo certeza del pasaje salvo que el Ben.”
